findings.description: Enter key hardcodes `IME_ACTION_DONE` instead of checking the field's `EditorInfo` for the appropriate IME action (SEARCH, GO, SEND, NEXT, etc.). FloatingKeyboardOverlay and KeyboardActivity both call `pressEnter()` which dynamically checks for `ACTION_IME_ENTER` support and falls back to newline. As a real IME, AIInputMethodService has access to `currentInputEditorInfo()` (via `onStartInputView`) and should use the same dynamic logic so Enter submits forms/searches on single-line fields.

VoiceBridgeServer generates a per-instance `authToken` (line 46) but this token is never exposed to any client. The server is started in ControllerAccessibilityService.onServiceConnected() but the token is not logged, stored, or shared via any IPC mechanism. If this endpoint is intended for local testing/debugging, there's no way for a legitimate client to authenticate. If it's only for internal future use, this should be documented or the auth removed.

REV=3 migration (lines 70-78) discards ALL user-customized button mappings from legacy profiles (rev < 3), keeping only tuning values (sensitivity/deadzone/cursorEnabled/invertScroll). This is a breaking data-loss change for existing users. While acknowledged as acceptable for AntiMicroX parity, it must be explicitly documented in release notes so users know their custom mappings will be reset.

styleLabel() logic is duplicated in FloatingKeyboardOverlay (line 319), AIInputMethodService (line 127), and KeyboardActivity (line 89) with identical implementations. commitStyledChar() per-character styling logic is also triplicated across all three keyboards (FloatingKeyboardOverlay line 488, AIInputMethodService line 283, KeyboardActivity line 227). Violates DRY and creates maintenance risk when style behavior changes. Consider extracting to TextStyles or a shared helper.

KeyboardActivity lacks font size controls (A+/A- buttons with KeyboardFontSizeStore integration), skin tone picker (🎨 button), voice button, and punctuation row that FloatingKeyboardOverlay and AIInputMethodService both have. The activity is labeled 'Open Legacy Keyboard (diagnostic)' in MainActivity, so this minimalism may be intentional. If KeyboardActivity is meant to remain as a fallback, the missing features should be documented.

testing_summary: Build compiles successfully (./gradlew compileDebugKotlin). No test suite exists in this port yet per AGENTS.md.
risk_rationale: Core user-intent issues (text injection, D-pad/hat-switch, Enter, voice append, drag-clamp) are fixed. One error (AIInputMethodService Enter key hardcodes IME_ACTION_DONE) affects a registered system IME. Two warnings: VoiceBridgeServer auth token unreachable, and ProfileSerializer REV=3 migration causes data loss without release-note documentation. DRY violations across three keyboards are a maintenance concern but not correctness issues.
